name: The Wild Bird Fund
neighborhoods: All five boroughs; walk-in center on Manhattan's Upper West Side
region_note: WILDLIFE (rehabilitation, NOT adoption - only NYS-licensed rehabbers may handle wild animals)
notes: NYC's only wildlife rehabilitation and education center. 501(c)(3). Accepts wild birds and small mammals 7 days a week; no appointment needed (leave a message if arriving near close). IMPORTANT LIMITATION: WBF CANNOT take exotic birds (budgies, parrots) or domestic birds (chickens, quail, domestic geese, tame doves) - for those go to ACC (as of 2022 the drop-off for domestic/exotic birds). WBF CAN take rock/domestic pigeons. Between 87th & 88th Streets. Email: (via wildbirdfund.org/contact) Intake: 'Found a Bird?' guidance at Intake: walk-in 565 Columbus Ave, daily 9am-7pm
type_raw: Wildlife rehabilitation & education center (NYC's main wildlife hospital)
